turns.question: For candidates who reached the interview stage between 30 September and 4 October 2026, what was the median number of days from their application to the interview stage?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no metric for median days from application to the interview stage, so I cannot give a figure. The closest metrics are Time to hire (days), which is the average days from applying to being hired over hired candidates, and Candidates in stage, which counts candidates in each hiring stage per day; I did not run either, so no freshness statement was returned.
